title: 대한민국 법정동 코드 (Legal Area Codes of South Korea)
description: Standardized 10-digit codes for South Korean legal administrative divisions (법정동 코드) up to four hierarchical levels: 시도 (province/special city), 시군구 (city/county/district), 읍면동 (town/township/neighborhood), 리 (village). Active codes only (deleted entries excluded). Sourced from www.code.go.kr.
